As it seems that some aren't able to reproduce it in just a tool script, here is the full original code that errors 
https://github.com/flametime/Godot-SpacetimeDB-SDK/blob/0.2/godot-client%2Faddons%2FSpacetimeDB%2Fui%2Fui.gd#L137-L140

Please provide an MRP to make this easier to test and fix:
- A small Godot project which reproduces the issue, with no unnecessary files included. Be sure to not include the `.godot` folder in the archive (but keep `project.godot`).
- Having an MRP is very important for contributors to be able to reproduce the bug in the same way that you are experiencing it. When testing a potential fix for the issue, contributors will use the MRP to validate that the fix is working as intended.
- Drag and drop a ZIP archive to upload it (max 10 MB). **Do not select another field until the project is done uploading.**
- **Note for C# users:** If your issue is *not* C#-specific, please upload a minimal reproduction project written in GDScript. This will make it easier for contributors to reproduce the issue locally as not everyone has a .NET setup available.

ok sorry for the late update.
this is turning out to be difficult. i made an mvp with a very similar setup but it doesn't crash there.
i tested the plugin in a different godot project and it also doesn't crash there with the exact code that crashes in the main project for the plugin.
the project settings don't have anything noteworthy besides that it has warning on untyped declarations on but i also tested that and makes no difference.

the weird thing is that it is 100% reliable in the project i get the crash on and couldn't replicate it in any other way or project. 
in the search i also noticed that we were using a deprecated dock function but even after changing that to the new setup, it is still crashing.

the rendering mode (forward +, compability and mobile) also doesn't affect this.
i also deleted the .godot folder to test if there is something that let's it crash and i still got crashed.
deleting the user:// folder also made no change.

here is the mvp but idk if it will be any help as i can't replicate it on there myself.

[bugtesting.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25031076/bugtesting.zip)

Yeah that's how my bug was too. Tho I was on windows. Is there a start flag to get the more detailed backtrace?

> Yeah that's how my bug was too. Tho I was on windows. Is there a start flag to get the more detailed backtrace?

Unfortunately not. The detail comes from a debug build that contains symbols and then reproducing the bug. The [instructions](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine_details/development/compiling/compiling_for_windows.html) are great, but they can be daunting. That is why MRP is so valuable; it allows those of us with debug builds to reproduce your problem and get the diagnostics needed to make our world a better place!

In this case, I think I have enough information to take a stab at a solution. Will poke at it tomorrow :)

Created a PR that should fix it. Also created a true MRP; it crashes just by loading it.

[placeholder-script-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28183085/placeholder-script-repro.zip)
Thanks. So at least it wasn't some "only on my PC in that specific project" problem. I had already given up on this issue as I couldn't even replicate it with the same code in another project.
